notes: I checked all 28 lines against the scan for words, consonants, vowels, dagesh, punctuation (mid-line period and final colon), (יְיָ) in parentheses on lines 7 and 20, and reading order from line 1 (מָקוֹם…) to line 28 (צַח וְאָדוֹם…).
